description: Strips JavaScript hydration payloads, theme DOM bloat, and inline SVGs/CSS from a live web page URL, returning clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) with front-loaded Schema.org tables that fit within the 25,000-token LLM context window. Use this tool when you need to read the actual text, pricing tables, or FAQs of a web page without HTML truncation; do not use it for a pass/fail readiness score (use audit_ai_readiness instead) or to generate /llms.txt manifests (use generate_ai_manifests instead). Preserves the exact URL path and query string passed in url rather than normalizing to the root domain. Read-only HTTP extraction; requires no API key, allows 60 req/min, and returns an isError flag if the remote URL returns HTTP 4xx/5xx or times out after 8 seconds.

url.description: Fully qualified HTTPS URL of the specific web page to convert into clean Markdown (e.g., "https://vercel.com/pricing"). Defaults to HTTPS if scheme is omitted.

name: extract_byte0_markdown
title: Extract Clean Byte-0 Markdown & Schema Tables from URL
